title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Red Slush Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Red Slush Nic Salt is a juicy mix of Cherry and Mixed Berries, finished with a slushy-style Ice exhale. Its sweet, bright, and brisk on the finish ideal for vapers who enjoy chilled fruit blends. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt is perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for smooth, fast nicotine absorption. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers. This liquid is perfect for refillable vape and vape starter kit users.
